item.title: extraversion
item.description: Overview Extraversion, also spelled extroversion, is a personality or character trait that psychometric instruments aim to measure around orientation towards stimulation from the external world like social interactions.

item.title: Novelty-Seeking
item.description: Overview In the field of psychology, the term “novelty-seeking” is considered a core personality or character trait that has substantial empirical backing in psychology and biology.

item.title: Inner Work
item.description: Overview “Inner work” is a term that’s widely used in pop psychology, though it’s rooted in ideas going back to Carl Jung about reflecting on one’s psyche as an internal world that interacts with the external world.
